title: Illumina COVIDSeq Test: Pool and Clean Up Libraries
author: Opentrons
materials: Pick up 20 uL tips from slot 7
Pause protocol for vortexing and centrifuging 8-strip tube.
Aspirate 55 uL from A1 of 8-strip tube

steps.title: Engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Activate the magnetic module and wait 3 minutes for the beads to pellet.

steps.title: Transfer 5 µL to strip tubes
steps.instruction: Move 5 µL from the magnetic plate into the 8‑strip PCR tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a 20 µL tip from slot 7.
Aspirate 5 µL from column 1, well A1 of the magnetic plate located in slot 3.
Dispense the 5 µL into the appropriate well of the 8‑strip PCR tube.

steps.title: Vortex and centrifuge strip
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and manually vortex then centrifuge the 8‑strip PCR tube.

steps.title: Transfer 55 µL to 1.7 mL tube
steps.instruction: Move 55 µL from the 8‑strip tube into a 1.7 mL tube in slot 6.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a single 200 µL tip from slot 4.
Aspirate 55 µL from well A1 of the 8‑strip tube.
Dispense the 55 µL into the 1.7 mL tube located in well A1 of slot 6.
Discard the tip into the trash.
